title.zh: 将西米萨米斯省普拉里德尔市镇帕纳尔萨兰描笼涯的Lobog桥重新命名为Alfonso Burlat Apdujan桥的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Lobog Bridge, Traversing Barangay Panalsalan in the Municipality of Plaridel, Province of Misamis Occidental, as Alfonso Burlat Apdujan Bridge
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Lobog Bridge, Traversing Barangay Panalsalan in the Municipality of Plaridel, Province of Misamis Occidental, as Alfonso Burlat Apdujan Bridge

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11827_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Lobog Bridge, traversing Barangay Panalsalan in the Municipality of Plaridel, Province of Misamis Occidental, is hereby renamed as Alfonso Burlat Apdujan Bridge.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
